subPoints: built-in functions: Effective use of Pandas functions.
Data Cleaning & Preparation: Very nicely done (e.g., dropping duplicates, handling missing values)!
DataFrame Display: Nicely displayed Pandas DataFrames for better readability.
Absolute Value: Good on taking the absolute value of the data for analysis.
Correlation Analysis: Well done.
Merging DataFrames: The merge of data was incorrect or not done well.
Running Averages: Good inea on performing a running averages of the data.
Sorting: Good job on sorting the data for easier interpretation/understanding.
Statitical Analysis: Good job on interpreting the statistical analysis.
Delimiter (`sep`): Incorrectly specified the separator used within the CSV-formatted file.
Function Creation: Creating a function to read in the data is not necessary and adds unnecessary complexity to the code.
Header (`header`): Incorrectly specified the header line.
Incorrectly loading of the data.
New Object: Creating a new object that is string of the input file is uneeded - not concise coding when using it once.
Renaming File: Renaming the source data file is generally not a good practice.
Presentation: Data should have been presented better as a DataFrame table (i.e., not using `print(DataFrame)` for better readability.
Data Cleaning: The data was not cleaned properly (e.g., dropping duplicates, handling missing values).
Data Modification: Cleaned/modifed data was not saved to memory(`df = df.method(...)`) or using the `inplace=True` argument.
Correlation Analysis: Did not use Pandas' built-in correlation function.
Absolute Value: You needed to take the absolute value of the data for analysis.
Interpretation: Lack of interpreting what the statitical analysis means (i.e., context is missing).
Merging DataFrames: The merge of data was incorrect or not done well.
The data was not plotted using the Pandas' built-in methods, which was a requirement for the assignment.
Sorting: The data was not sorted, or the sorting was incorrect/not saved.
Final Data Not Saved: The final processed data was not saved to a file.
Saving Index: Saving the default numerical index was unnecessary for the resulting data file.
